page.overview:
Who is Cassie Cage?

Christina Eenigenburg (MK11) (Model) |Fighting Styles=Karate (MKX, MK11) Shinto Ryu (MKX, MK11)Shorin Ryu (MKX, MK11)}}

Cassandra Carlton "Cassie" Cage is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A former sergeant and commander of the Special Forces, Cassie is the daughter of Johnny Cage and Sonya Blade in the second timeline. She, alongside Takeda, Kung Jin, and Jacqui Briggs are known collectively as the Kombat Kids.

Cassie made her playable debut in Mortal Kombat X, serving as one of the protagonists in the game's Story Mode alongside Takeda, Kung Jin and Jacqui.

Cassie returned in Mortal Kombat 11 as a playable character and supporting character in the game's Story Mode.
